title: Audit stale K4168 Naihe authority, address, receipt, operator, signer, and parent-evidence lineage without deploying, appointing, funding, transferring, or mutating chain state
reason: PR 172 is a generally well-labeled, paper-only, fail-closed design candidate, but it cannot establish live controller, treasury, reservoir, operator, signer, governance, receipt, custody, settlement, transformation, or parent-evidence authority. Its chain snapshot is a historical observation from 2026-08-22 at BSC block 117495395 and explicitly marks the fixed EOA's controller and authority unverified. Its schema accepts caller-authored authority and receipt labels without cryptographic provider, signer, freshness, revocation, or authoritative-registry binding, while its simulator accepts caller-injected Mengpo IDs, test addresses, balances, receipt flags, and in-memory replay sets. Current main contains none of the ten candidate changes. The safe action is a current-main audit record only, with no candidate runtime, registry, indexes, workflow, address, balance, role, or authority transplanted.

inventory.security_blocker: No current authoritative controller, treasury, custody, source, reservoir deployment, Mengpo identity/operator registry, signer policy, governance decision, durable receipt verifier, atomic replay store, transformation rule, conservation verifier, or independent parent-evidence verifier exists.

blocking_findings: PR 172 is open, Draft, unmerged, diverged, and 144 commits behind exact current main; its PR body and sole comment describe older main/head evidence and cannot substitute for this exact-head audit.

The fixed Public Good label candidate 0xB73D6716005B37BEC742D64482fA26033eE1A4E1 is only a historical chain observation from 2026-08-22 at BSC block 117495395. The snapshot itself marks controller_status and authority_status UNVERIFIED and ownership OWNERSHIP_UNVERIFIED_PUBLIC_CIRCULATING.

An EOA address, one observed transaction, historical KGEN/BNB balances, zero KAIOS balance, and empty code do not prove current controller, signer, treasury ownership, custody, budget, funding availability, purpose, or authorization.

The reservoir is NOT_DEPLOYED, its address is null, active_pool_count is zero, and Mengpo is NOT_REGISTERED as Life or Worker. No source, destination, custody, operator, beneficiary, or settlement authority exists.

The JSON schema permits plain caller-authored authority_id, approver, signer_policy, authorization_status, receipt_id, receipt_hash, and receipt status labels. It has no trusted provider, signature, key binding, freshness, chain-log binding, revocation, quorum, or authoritative-registry requirement.

The paper simulator accepts authorizedMengpoLifeIds and a reservoirAddress from its caller. A local string in the injected set plus caller strings AUTHORIZED_PAPER_ONLY and VERIFIED_PAPER can authorize a paper draw without authenticating a real Life, Worker, operator, controller, signer, receipt, or Human decision.

Refill source and destination balances are supplied by the caller. Equality checks provide internal arithmetic consistency but do not verify chain state, token transfer logs, source ownership, destination custody, settlement finality, or authorization.

Replay controls, pool balances, draws, transformations, doses, Genesis IDs, and investment returns are process-local in-memory collections, not durable, atomic, globally serialized, or exactly-once production state.

KGEN and KAIOS pool eligibility in the candidate registry is design metadata. Deployed token addresses and merged scale Canon do not activate a K4168 pool, approve a source, create reserves, appoint an operator, or authorize conversion or transfer.

The transformation test uses TEST_ONLY_FROZEN_MOCK and a fabricated 0.008 BNB output relationship. It does not prove a production conversion asset, rate, oracle, conservation rule, funding source, signer, recipient, or executable settlement.

Parent assignment currently fails closed, which is correct, but the schema can still carry SEPARATELY_VERIFIED and INDEPENDENT_BIRTH_RECORD_EVIDENCE labels without an implemented trusted parent-evidence verifier. Those strings are not authority evidence.
PR 168 is merged Canon vocabulary only. Closed-unmerged PRs 163 and 197 are historical candidates and supply no runtime, controller, signer, operator, funding, deployment, or governance authority.
The Sol/曜冊 relay is text provenance only and cannot authenticate identity, controller, operator, signer, parent, Worker, Life, employment, or Human authority.

The branch-specific workflow has contents: read, exact-head checkout, and no secrets or writes, but it is obsolete for current main and actions/checkout@v4 plus actions/setup-node@v4 emitted Node.js 20 deprecation warnings.

Historical 32/32 exact-head tests prove only local paper invariants. They cannot manufacture current balances, authority, custody, deployment, receipt validity, a Human decision, a Worker/Life, a signer, a transaction, delivery, settlement, or parenthood.
positive_findings: The package consistently labels itself DESIGN_ONLY_NOT_LIVE, Deployment NONE, Mainnet write NONE, and separates sponsor, source, reservoir, service operator, soup, and regeneration-parent roles.
The registry requires reservoir status NOT_DEPLOYED, reservoir address null, active_pool_count zero, and prevents undeployed assets from becoming eligible pools.
The simulator runs only in PAPER_TEST mode, uses no network, signer, wallet, secret, external API, workflow dispatch, or chain-write code, and rejects production mode.
Company membership, onboarding, sponsorship, reservoir, Mengpo, and soup do not establish parenthood; non-orphan assignment fails with PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_AUTHORITY_UNBOUND.

The model checks duplicate draw and Genesis IDs, role collisions, scale matching, reserve floors, draw limits, mass and energy arithmetic, selected transformation output, exact BNB amount, recipient binding, and direct Public Good-to-Life payment rejection.
The workflow grants contents: read only, checks out the exact PR head with persisted credentials disabled, and the exact-head run completed 32/32 tests with zero failures.
safe_successor_requirements: Obtain current, independently verifiable controller and beneficial-authority evidence for every source, treasury, reservoir, signer, operator, recipient, and custody address; public addresses and observed balances alone are insufficient.

Deploy or select a reservoir only under action-specific Human authorization, reviewed immutable configuration, chain ID, verified bytecode, owner/admin controls, pause and rollback path, reserve segmentation, and exact address evidence.

Bind Mengpo to an authoritative Life and Worker registry entry, controller, consent, capabilities, scope, expiry, Claim, lease, fencing token, and revocation before any operator action; no onboarding or appointment occurs in this audit.

Replace caller-authored status labels with signed or independently attested authority and receipt evidence that binds provider, subject, chain, contract, asset, amount, source, destination, block or round, timestamp, freshness, revocation, purpose, and unique replay key.

Use a durable atomic ledger for receipt verification, consumption, custody transition, balance mutation, transformation, delivery, and accounting. Process-local sets and caller-supplied before/after balances are not production replay protection.

Freeze and review every production transformation input/output asset, amount, scale, rounding, loss, byproduct, catalyst, oracle, conservation rule, authorized organ, and settlement path before execution.
Implement a separately reviewed parent-evidence verifier. Repository strings, company membership, payment, service, controller, comments, or local fixtures must never assign a regeneration parent.

Do not transplant the obsolete branch workflow or candidate indexes to current main. If a general paper-model validator is later needed, rebuild it on exact current main with current actions and no codex/* trigger.

Never deploy, fund, transfer, trade, pay, appoint a controller/signer/operator, activate a Worker/Life, access credentials, dispatch a workflow, call a paid API, launch an external agent, send a Mainnet transaction, execute governance, or mutate chain state as part of this audit.
